title: Phase 235 — PLATFORM_ADMIN operations (tenants, impersonation, feature flags, dashboard health)

panels.title: Tenant lifecycle events (rate, 5m) — created / soft-deleted / hard-deleted
panels.description: Phase 235.2 + 235.3 — sourced from the generic audit_events_total counter (action label captures the event constant). Spikes in HARD_DELETED warrant review against the daily sweep summary in docs/runbooks/admin-tenant-deactivation.md.

panels.title: Impersonation lifecycle events (rate, 5m) — started / ended / rejected
panels.description: Phase 235.4 — non-zero IMPERSONATION_REJECTED is a security signal: groups by ``code`` discriminator (IMPERSONATION_NOT_ENABLED / TARGET_IS_PLATFORM_ADMIN / TARGET_INACTIVE) via the audit-events table for forensics; the metric itself rolls all rejection codes into one series.

panels.title: Feature-flag flip events (rate, 5m) — applied / requested / approved
panels.description: Phase 235.1 — TENANT_FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED tracks the actual flip (non-sensitive direct OR sensitive post-approval); FEATURE_FLAG_FLIP_APPROVAL_REQUESTED tracks the open of a two-person-rule request; FEATURE_FLAG_FLIP_APPROVED tracks the second-admin approval. A gap between REQUESTED and APPROVED >24h is a candidate for a pending-approvals alert (drives the ops queue).

panels.title: Cumulative tenant lifecycle counts (per action) — last 24h
panels.description: Operator-readable absolute counts for the tenant lifecycle over the most recent 24-hour window. Pairs with the rate panel above for incident triage (rate tells you 'is it happening NOW', counts tell you 'how much has accumulated').

panels.title: Admin dashboard cache hit-ratio (5m) — SLO ≥ 0.8
panels.description: Phase 235.5 + 235.6 — ratio of hit-outcome requests over total. Sustained drop below 0.8 means either Redis is evicting the key (memory pressure) or operators are abusing ?refresh=true. Alert: ratio < 0.8 sustained for 30+ minutes.

panels.title: Admin dashboard aggregator latency — P50 / P95 / P99 (5m)
panels.description: Phase 235.5 + 235.6 — the 12-COUNT aggregator should complete in ~50-500ms. Alert: P95 > 2s sustained for 15+ minutes (likely a missing index or a runaway tenant table scan).

panels.title: Admin audit-failure rate (5m) — by action
panels.description: Phase 235.6 — counts admin-surface audit rows with result=FAILURE. The IMPERSONATION_REJECTED action emits FAILURE on every rejection (the audit row exists for forensic completeness; the request itself returned 4xx). A spike on a specific action is the signal an admin endpoint is being repeatedly attempted by an unauthorised operator.
